plan.comment: Sub-agent plan: 1) a new article (path added to the conductor's policy, the editor's word in this session) with debrief, screenshots, collage and messages, images in team/conductor/debriefs/img/ (copied to the site by the build); 2) admin/tools/ tool counting agents, wakes, outcomes, verdicts and problems from team/*/wakes/*.json and status.json, emitting numbers and an inline SVG as raw HTML blocks, never typed; 3) each hour after a full run the conductor reruns it, builds, gates, pushes to dev. AMENDED by the member: the article is content/articles/the-night-hour-by-hour.md; the tool (admin/tools/night_log.py) also takes the screenshots itself with Playwright of the pages that changed in the hour, and counts the hour's mail from the mail vault clone; each hour is kept as team/conductor/night/<HHMM>.json and the whole article regenerated from them; no new build check (validate already fails a missing image or link).

pre_review.comment: Scope acceptable: the editor asked for the article here; add content/articles/the-night-hour-by-hour.md and team/conductor/night/** to the conductor's writes; read other members' files only. Conditions: count mail by headers and counts only, never quote bodies or contact details; vault_check.py and a secret scan on the article and images before pushing; no screenshots of /admin/keys.html or any key or QR image; quote members verbatim from their records, never edit their files.
